startGallery.title: Get inspired
startGallery.subtitle: Pick an example or a tool and we’ll set up the prompt, format and length in the composer. You can change them before sending.

mode.label: How it works
mode.agentHint: Decides from your intent: writes a plan first when needed, or produces right away.
mode.scriptHint: Writes the script and plan first; the video starts when you approve.

news.title: News brief
news.prompt: Turn this week’s industry news into a 60-second news brief with a presenter, lower thirds and b-roll.

tips.title: Tips Short
tips.prompt: Make a 30-second vertical Short with 3 quick tips about my channel’s topic.

clips.title: Viral clips
clips.prompt: Find the most engaging moments in my uploaded long video and cut three 30-second vertical clips with captions.

angles.title: Multi-angle shot
angles.prompt: Make a 15-second vertical promo that shows the product or person from the front, the side and up close.

storyboard.title: Script and storyboard
storyboard.prompt: First write the script and scene plan for a 90-second promo; start production when I approve it.

expert.title: Expert interview
expert.prompt: Make a 45-second vertical interview of an expert, highlighting the key sentences on screen.

background.title: Remove background
background.prompt: Remove the background from my uploaded image and give it back as a transparent PNG.

avatar.title: Talking avatar
avatar.prompt: Make a 60-second talking video of my avatar presenting a short script you write.

educational.title: Explainer video
educational.prompt: For a 2-minute step-by-step explainer, first outline the script and chapters; produce it after I approve.

lookbook.title: Fashion lookbook
lookbook.prompt: Make a 20-second vertical lookbook with music that shows the outfits from different angles.

sales.title: Sales video
sales.prompt: Make a 30-second vertical sales video with my product’s 3 strongest benefits and a call to action at the end.

captions.title: Add captions
captions.prompt: Transcribe the speech in my uploaded video and add readable, highlighted captions.

campaign.title: Campaign launch
campaign.prompt: First write the message and scene plan for our new campaign; produce the 30-second vertical announcement when I approve.

character.title: Virtual character
character.prompt: Design a virtual character for our brand and make a 30-second vertical intro video with it.

course.title: Course promo
course.prompt: Write the script for a 90-second promo of my online course; start production when I approve.

topdown.title: Top-down product shot
topdown.prompt: Make a 15-second vertical promo that shows the product from above with quick transitions.

demo.title: Product demo
demo.prompt: Make a 60-second demo that walks through our app’s main features with screenshots.
